Description: This template creates a Backup Compliance Policy on the MongoDB Atlas API, this will be billed to your Atlas account.

Profile.Description: Secret Manager Profile that contains the Atlas Programmatic keys

ProjectId.Description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project

AuthorizedEmail.Description: Email address of the user authorized to update the Backup Compliance Policy settings

AuthorizedUserFirstName.Description: First name of the user authorized to update the Backup Compliance Policy settings

AuthorizedUserLastName.Description: Last name of the user authorized to update the Backup Compliance Policy settings

CopyProtectionEnabled.Description: Flag that indicates whether to enable additional copy protection for the cluster

EncryptionAtRestEnabled.Description: Flag that indicates whether Encryption at Rest using Customer Key Management is required

PitEnabled.Description: Flag that indicates whether the cluster uses Continuous Cloud Backup

RestoreWindowDays.Description: Number of days back in time you can restore to with Continuous Cloud Backup accuracy

OnDemandFrequencyInterval.Description: Number that indicates the frequency interval for on-demand snapshots

OnDemandRetentionUnit.Description: Unit of time in which MongoDB Cloud measures snapshot retention for on-demand

OnDemandRetentionValue.Description: Duration that MongoDB Cloud retains the on-demand snapshot

HourlyFrequencyInterval.Description: Desired frequency of hourly snapshots (in hours)

HourlyRetentionUnit.Description: Unit of time in which MongoDB Cloud measures snapshot retention for hourly

HourlyRetentionValue.Description: Duration that MongoDB Cloud retains the hourly snapshot

DailyFrequencyInterval.Description: Desired frequency of daily snapshots (in days)

DailyRetentionUnit.Description: Unit of time in which MongoDB Cloud measures snapshot retention for daily

DailyRetentionValue.Description: Duration that MongoDB Cloud retains the daily snapshot

WeeklyFrequencyInterval.Description: Desired frequency of weekly snapshots (in weeks)

WeeklyRetentionUnit.Description: Unit of time in which MongoDB Cloud measures snapshot retention for weekly

WeeklyRetentionValue.Description: Duration that MongoDB Cloud retains the weekly snapshot

MonthlyFrequencyInterval.Description: Desired frequency of monthly snapshots (in months)

MonthlyRetentionUnit.Description: Unit of time in which MongoDB Cloud measures snapshot retention for monthly

MonthlyRetentionValue.Description: Duration that MongoDB Cloud retains the monthly snapshot

PolicyProjectId.Description: The unique identifier of the project for the Backup Compliance Policy

PolicyState.Description: Current state of the Backup Compliance Policy settings (ACTIVE or INACTIVE)

PolicyUpdatedDate.Description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC of when the Backup Compliance Policy settings were last updated

PolicyUpdatedUser.Description: Email address of the user who last updated the Backup Compliance Policy settings
